children: Avient reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $891.2 million, net income of $42.7 million and diluted EPS of $0.46, up from $806.5 million, $32.6 million and $0.36, respectively, in the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Sales”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to Avient common shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Earnings per share attributable to Avient common shareholders - Diluted”.
Sales growth was supported by demand in growth-vector markets, favorable mix and pricing, with gains across major end markets.
Specialty Engineered Materials sales rose 14.4%, led by demand in defense, industrial, consumer and high-performance computing markets.
Color, Additives and Inks sales increased 8.2%, supported by packaging and consumer demand for functional additives and color solutions.
Operating income improved in both segments as higher sales, favorable mix, productivity and restructuring savings offset cost pressures.
Management said available cash sources are expected to cover foreseeable needs, while citing demand, input costs, tariffs and supply-chain risks.
